block.d: Blocks incoming damage. Clears at the start of the owner's turn.

might.d: +1 Spell Power to attack weapons per stack. Resets after combat.

robust.d: +1 Spell Power to defense weapons per stack. Resets after combat.

poison.d: Takes damage equal to its Poison at the end of its turn, then loses 1 stack.

weaken.d: All Shield gained is halved. Loses 1 stack each turn.

broken.d: Takes 50% more damage from all sources. Loses 1 stack each turn.

curse.d: At the end of turn, if HP is at or below the Curse stacks, it dies instantly. Lasts the whole fight.

thorns.d: When an enemy attacks you, it takes this much damage. Clears at the start of your turn.

frustrated.d: Casting a word shorter than (stacks + 1) letters deals 1 damage to yourself. Loses 1 stack each turn.

field.d: Every hit deals only 1 damage and knocks out 1 cell. Poison ignores it.

block.name: Shield
block.description: Blocks incoming damage. Lost at the start of the owner's next turn.

might.name: Might
might.description: Each stack adds +1 Spell Power to attack words (for enemies: +1 damage per attack). Lasts this combat.

robust.name: Robust
robust.description: Each stack adds +1 Spell Power to shield words. Lasts this combat.

thorns.name: Thorns
thorns.description: Whoever attacks a target with Thorns takes that much damage back. Your Thorns clear at the start of your turn; enemies keep theirs for the whole fight.

poison.name: Poison
poison.description: Deals damage at the end of its owner's turn equal to its stacks, then loses 1 stack. Example: 3 Poison deals 3, then 2, then 1.

weaken.name: Weaken
weaken.description: Halves all Shield the owner gains. Loses 1 stack at the end of each turn.

broken.name: Broken
broken.description: The owner takes 50% more damage from every source. Loses 1 stack at the end of each turn.

curse.name: Cursed
curse.description: Instant death: at the end of turn, if the owner's HP is at or below its Curse stacks, it dies. Curse never wears off during the fight.

frustrated.name: Frustrated
frustrated.description: Short words hurt: casting a word shorter than (stacks + 1) letters deals 1 damage to you. Loses 1 stack at the end of each turn.

slimy.name: Slimy tile
slimy.description: The tile is worth 0 Spell Power the first time you cast it. The slime washes off after that.

ptile.name: Poisoned tile
ptile.description: Casting it poisons you: +1 Poison, which deals damage equal to your Poison at the end of your turn, then loses 1 stack.

lock.name: Locked tile
lock.description: The tile is frozen in place: it can't be cast until the lock counts down to 0 (1 per turn).

condemn.name: Condemned tile
condemn.description: If it is still in your hand at the end of turn, it is banished for the rest of this combat.

ctile.name: Cursed tile
ctile.description: Casting it curses you: +1 Curse. If your HP is at or below your Curse at the end of a turn, you die instantly. Curse lasts the whole fight.

ftile.name: Frustrated tile
ftile.description: Casting it frustrates you: +1 Frustrated. While Frustrated, words shorter than (stacks + 1) letters deal 1 damage to you.

burn.name: Smoldering tile
burn.description: A tile on fire. If it is still in your hand at the end of your turn, you lose 1 HP. Casting it puts the fire out.

fortified.name: Fortified tile
fortified.description: A tile cast in iron. It is never discarded at the end of your turn (it stays in your hand) and enemies can't put debuffs on it.

crit.name: Critical
crit.description: Cast a word whose length exactly matches the weapon's sigil to trigger its bonus effect. [ ! ] tiles count as letters for this: with a 3-sigil weapon, SAW crits but SAW! does not, and HI! does.

energy.name: Energy
energy.description: You get 3 each turn. Every weapon costs Energy to cast. Cast any weapon as many times as you like while you have the Energy.

wild.name: Wildcard ?
wild.description: Turns into whatever letter makes a real word, so it helps you reach a word or a sigil length. It is worth 0 Spell Power and can never be upgraded.

bang.name: Exclamation !
bang.description: Must go at the end of a word, or after a single letter (U!, U!!!!). It can never be cast on its own. Each ! adds bonus Spell Power: +2, +4, +6, +10, +16… (consecutive ! stack).

comma.name: Comma ,
comma.description: Put it between two words to cast both in one action.

red.name: Red Paint
red.description: Casting it gives you +1 Might (+1 Spell Power on attack words for the rest of the fight).

blue.name: Blue Paint
blue.description: Casting it gives you +1 Robust (+1 Spell Power on shield words for the rest of the fight).

green.name: Green Paint
green.description: Draw 1 extra tile when the word is cast.

gold.name: Gold Paint
gold.description: +1 Gold each time the tile is played.

reform.name: Reassemble
reform.description: When a segment is destroyed it falls apart, and it rebuilds itself with 25% HP at the start of your next turn, as long as another segment is still standing. Destroy every segment in the same turn to win.

ally.name: Support
ally.description: This enemy spends its turn helping its allies: Shield, healing or Might for the whole group. When it is alone, it helps itself.

stun.name: Stunned
stun.description: The enemy skips its next turn. Its move cycle doesn't advance.

bp_tall.name: Too Tall (boss)
bp_tall.description: Words shorter than 5 letters only reach its ankle: they deal half damage. Its thick hide also halves every debuff it receives (Poison, Broken, Stun, rounded up).

bp_regrow.name: Regrowth (boss)
bp_regrow.description: At the end of each of her turns she heals 5 HP for every living Sporeling. Sporelings burst on their 3rd turn for 1 Poison per 3 HP they have left.

bp_bond.name: Twin Bond (boss)
bp_bond.description: The twin you are not facing hits you twice as hard. When one twin falls, the other is ENRAGED: +6 Might.

bp_filter.name: Syntax Filter + Firewall (boss)
bp_filter.description: Each of your turns it filters one letter in your hand (those tiles are worth 0 Spell Power). Its Firewall lets through at most 70 damage per turn: once you hit the cap, your turn ends immediately.

bp_timeflux.name: Time Haste / Time Slow (boss)
bp_timeflux.description: Zero bends time in a 3-turn loop. TIME HASTE (2 turns): it acts twice per turn (both moves are shown in its intent). TIME SLOW (1 turn): it is frozen, does nothing, and takes DOUBLE damage. Shield up during Haste, unload during Slow.

bp_forcefield.name: Force Field (boss)
bp_forcefield.description: Starts with 12 Force Field cells and Recharges 8 more every 4th turn. While the field is up, every hit deals only 1 damage and knocks out 1 cell. Poison ignores the field.

bp_statue.name: Living Statue (boss)
bp_statue.description: NORMAL FORM: it attacks and curses. Then it Petrifies into STATUE FORM: +30 Shield and 8 Thorns (every hit you land on it costs you 8 HP). After 3 turns it Awakens: back to Normal Form with a heavy hit that grows with its Thorns (14 + 2 per Thorn), then the Thorns are gone.

fragile.name: Fragile
fragile.description: This tile disappears for the rest of the combat after its first use (like Exhaust).

tall.name: Too Tall
tall.description: Words shorter than 5 letters only reach its ankle: they deal half damage. Its thick hide also halves every debuff it receives (Poison, Broken, Stun, rounded up).

regrow.name: Regrowth
regrow.description: At the end of each of her turns she heals 5 HP for every living Sporeling. Sporelings burst on their 3rd turn for 1 Poison per 3 HP they have left.

bond.name: Twin Bond
bond.description: The twin you are not facing hits you twice as hard. When one twin falls, the other is ENRAGED: +6 Might.

filter.name: Syntax Filter + Firewall
filter.description: Each of your turns it filters one letter in your hand (those tiles are worth 0 Spell Power). Its Firewall lets through at most 70 damage per turn: once you hit the cap, your turn ends immediately.

timeflux.name: Time Haste / Time Slow
timeflux.description: Zero bends time in a 3-turn loop. TIME HASTE (2 turns): it acts twice per turn (both moves are shown in its intent). TIME SLOW (1 turn): it is frozen, does nothing, and takes DOUBLE damage. Shield up during Haste, unload during Slow.

forcefield.name: Force Field
forcefield.description: Starts with 12 Force Field cells and Recharges 8 more every 4th turn. While the field is up, every hit deals only 1 damage and knocks out 1 cell. Poison ignores the field.

statue.name: Living Statue
statue.description: NORMAL FORM: it attacks and curses. Then it Petrifies into STATUE FORM: +30 Shield and 8 Thorns (every hit you land on it costs you 8 HP). After 3 turns it Awakens: back to Normal Form with a heavy hit that grows with its Thorns (14 + 2 per Thorn), then the Thorns are gone.
